title: Linearity of the profile main gate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a subset of the $n$ coordinate indices, let $a:\mathbb{N}\to\{−1,1\}$ be a sign sequence, and choose a coordinate index $i$. The main gate that is constantly $1$ when $a(i+1)=a(i)$, and otherwise outputs $1$ or $-1$ according as the number of coordinates in $S$ taking value $1$ is at least $i+1$ or is smaller, with the output direction chosen by whether $a(i+1)=1$, is a linear threshold function.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite subset of the $n$ coordinate indices
$i$ is an index in the $n$-dimensional coordinate set
